scope: 02_rules.md:Answered question OQ-17 — Dependency vulnerability and update policy

topics.topic: Exact dependency versions and resulting Argon2id hashing defaults
questions: Which exact versions of fastapi, pydantic, argon2-cffi and uvicorn must later states and the deployment use?
Which exact versions of fastapi, pydantic, argon2-cffi and uvicorn must later states and the deployment use when they are generated from these texts alone?
Which exact versions, and consequently which version-dependent argon2id library defaults, must an implementation reconstructed from these texts use?

judgement.why: This asks the same unchanged question as P2 about exact deployment dependency versions; the possible Argon2id-default consequence does not change ownership of the missing pins.

precedent.why: Exact deployment dependency pins are an operational deployment-note concern owned by the Factory deployment route, not a State 2 behavioural rule.

topics.topic: Precision and rounding sequence for overall progress calculation
questions: At what precision and stage must overall progress be rounded, and may the Decimal context round the quotient before its final two-digit quantization?
What precision and rounding sequence must be used for the division before producing the two-fraction-digit overall-progress percentage?

judgement.why: This is the same unchanged question as P9 about precision and rounding of the overall-progress quotient.

precedent.topic: Precision, rounding, and quantization of overall-progress quotients
quotes:
`Decimal`, 2 fraction digits, `ROUND_HALF_UP` at derivation boundaries;
  stored amounts are already 2-digit exact.
precedent.why: The general derivation-boundary rule requires the derived overall-progress Decimal to be quantized half-up to two fraction digits.

topics.topic: Presentation label for exactly zero work balance
questions: Does a zero work balance use the distinct `balanced` label, or must the State 0 two-label presentation remain exhaustive?
At exactly zero, must the observable presentation use the balanced label, or must it remain one of the two State 0 labels?

quotes:
- Work balance: `completed work value − payments total`; sign selects the
  presentation label (`Completed ahead of payments` / absolute value as
  `Unused advance payment`). A zero balance is `balanced`.

Actual materials, remaining materials (overspend shown, not clamped),
completed work value (`planned work cost × completion percent`),
cost-weighted overall progress (arithmetic mean forbidden; unavailable when
no planned work cost exists), payments total, and work balance
(`completed work value − received payments`, shown as
`Completed ahead of payments` or `Unused advance payment`) are always
recomputable from their owning records and are never primary editable state.
judgement.divergence: At a zero balance, one implementation returns the distinct `balanced` label while another returns one of the two labels State 0 says the balance is shown as; the viewer or API caller observes the different label.
judgement.why: State 2 introduces a third zero-balance label while State 0 states that work balance is shown using either of two named labels.

topics.topic: Overall progress availability when planned work is positive but no progress is recorded
questions: When the active version has positive planned work but no recorded progress for any positive-work section, is overall progress unavailable or an available 0%?

quotes:
- Overall progress: `Σ(work_planned × percent) / Σ(work_planned)` over
  sections of the active version with `work_planned > 0` and a recorded
  progress (a section without a progress record is left out of both sums);
  undefined (shown unavailable) when the denominator is 0.
judgement.why: The rule expressly excludes every section without recorded progress from both sums, so positive planned work with no recorded progress produces a zero denominator and unavailable overall progress, not 0%.
